**Research methods:**

- Visit the American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID) website to find members in Columbus
- Ask your regular dentist for referrals
- Check if they're board-certified in implant dentistry

**What to look for:**
- Years of implant experience
- Before/after photos of their work
- Clear explanation of the procedure and costs
- Good patient reviews specifically mentioning implants
- Consultation availability
